description: Informations sur les stations vélos « levelo » à Marseille is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Les stations de vélos électriques « levelo » à Marseille proposant l’identifiant, le nom, la capacité, la position, la disponibilité etc. de chaque station vélo. Ces données sont mises à jour toutes les 10mn. Pour accéder aux données en temps réel, les données au format GBFS sont disponibles:. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Station vélo, vélo électrique, Marseille, La Métropole Mobilité, Smart Services. The portal shows 228 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
